package.name: Workshop Documents
package.description: Documents for made parts: drawing sheets (standard views, sections, dimensions with ISO 286 fits, hole callouts, a title block) as SVG, PDF, DXF and a TechDraw page; assembly manuals with exploded steps and a bill of materials; patent figures and a draft for an attorney; library packs of STEP and STL with a README, a licence and credits and nothing personal in the files. Its own workbench (Workshop Documents) with a button for each and a Manual panel; a Python API (workshop_documents.api); tools for agents through Agent Link for FreeCAD when it is installed. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the FreeCAD project or the FPA.

workbench.name: Workshop Documents
workbench.description: Drawing sheets, exploded assembly manuals, patent figures and library packs.
